issues.description: The problem statement (UML) and solution expect a Stock method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), but the template Stock class provides a method named addItem(StockIngredient) instead. This name mismatch is structural — students following the UML or solution will call addToStockIngredients and get a compilation error when using the provided template, or they may be confused which method to implement/use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock API match the UML and solution by renaming or adding the method addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) in the template (e.g., rename addItem to addToStockIngredients or provide addToStockIngredients as a wrapper that calls addItem). Alternatively, update the problem statement to reference addItem consistently, but aligning the template to the UML is recommended to avoid student confusion.
